title: Chard, olive and spring onion squares

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Flour, oil, vinegar, olives, seeds and fresh garden veg are all ordinary home ingredients, with no factory-made products.

supermarket.reason: Every item is an everyday mainstream supermarket buy.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a bowl, a baking dish and an oven, and the mix-and-bake method suits a beginner.

works.reason: 300g self-raising flour with 350ml of liquid, raised with bicarb and vinegar, gives a spreadable batter that should bake through in a 20 x 30cm dish in 30 minutes and make enough squares for four.

honest_times.reason: Shredding chard, slicing spring onions, chopping olives and mixing fits in 15 minutes, and the 30-minute bake matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, names match their ids, and only water is added unlisted.

seasonal_feel.reason: A chard-studded savoury bake is a fitting July snack, and the chard is the main vegetable rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a savoury snack bake with plenty of greens, olives and seeds that a family would happily eat.
